captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a macro lens with a compact cylindrical barrel design. It features a matte black outer barrel, a ribbed focus ring, and an inner extending barrel with a blue glass front element. The rear of the lens is fitted with a grey metal bayonet mount and a small locking pin, while the inner barrel slides forward along a prismatic joint for close focus.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a macro camera lens with a cylindrical barrel, an inner extending barrel containing a blue glass front element, a ridged focus ring, and a grey rear bayonet mount. The inner barrel should slide linearly for focusing, and the focus ring should rotate on a revolute joint.
captions.factory: The code constructs an ArticulatedObject by first defining materials (matte black, ribbed, grey metal, and blue glass). It builds the main outer barrel as a base cylinder, adds a rotatable focus ring using a cylinder patterned with radial rectangular ribs, and adds a rear bayonet mount with a locking pin. It then creates the inner extending barrel as a separate part (with a glass lens element) connected via a prismatic joint, and the focus ring connected via a revolute joint.
